text.body: ||śrīgaṇapatistotram|| dviradānana vighnakānanajvalana tvaṃ prathameśanaṃdana| madanapatimākhuvāhana jvalanābhāsitapiṃgalocana||1|| ahibaṃdhana raktacaṃdana priyadūrvāṅkurabhārapūjana|| śaśibhūṣaṇa bhaktapālana jvalanākṣāsva nijānnijāvana||2|| vividhāmaramartyanāyakaḥ prathitastvaṃ bhuvane vināyakaḥ|| tava kope'pi hi naiva nāyakastata eva tvamajo vināyaka||3|| balinigraha īśa keśavastripurākhyāsuranigrahe śivaḥ|| jagadudbhavavanesbjasaṃbhavaḥ sakalānjetumaho manobhavaḥ||4|| mahiṣāsuranigrahe śivā bhavamuktyai munayo dhutāśivāḥ|| yamapūjayadiṣṭasiddhaye varado me bhava ceṣṭasiddhaye||5|| gajakarṇaka mūṣakasthite varade tvayyabhaye hṛdi sthite|| jayalābharameṣṭasaṃpadāḥ khalu sarvatra kuto vadāpadāḥ||6|| saṃkalpitaṃ kāryamavighnamīśa drāksiddhimāyātu mamākhileśa|| pāpatrayaṃ me hara sanmatīśa tāpatrayaṃ me hara śāṃtyadhīśa||7|| gaṇādhīśo dhīśo hariharavidhīśosbhayakaro guṇādhīśo dhīśo vijayata umāhṛtsukhakaraḥ| budhādhīśo nīśo nijabhajakavighnaughaharakaḥ mudādhīśo pīśo yaśasa ubhayardheśca śaraṇam||8|| iti śrīvāsudevānandasarasvatīviracitaṃ gaṇapatistotraṃ saṃpūrṇam||
